Before starting 
 any work on the motor, check that it is switched off and blocked up for 
 switching on again.

Tools and Equipment
Tool set for tightness, cleaning tools as cloth.... etc
Lifting device, press-on and detaching device
AVO 
 meter and insulation test device

 noise level measuring devices.
Grease for 
 the bearing.
Work to be Carried Out
Measure the vibration and noise level.
Clean the heat exchanger.
Check the bearing visually.
Grease the bearing.
Measure the insulation resistance for stator winding.
Clean the inside terminal box, and retighten bolts and ground 
 them.
General cleaning.
